changelog: Sleep Mode's time picker stays open — it used to close itself a moment after you opened it.
The (i) on Smart Schedule now opens the explainer: how it works, how savings are estimated, and what each parameter does.
Settings and Profile now show the same name — Settings could be left on a stale one after a rename.
Signing in as a different account no longer shows the previous account's name and linked email.
The Wi-Fi password eye now shows an open eye when the password is visible, not the reverse.
Add Device on Insights opens the scan straight away instead of stopping at the device list.
A device already registered elsewhere now says so: "Device already added to another account."
The three rings behind the device pulse outward while a scan is running.
A wrong verification code turns the whole code row red, with the message under it.
Add Device's No Devices Found screen has its artwork and its Search Again button back, and the found-device list keeps the header above it.
